newsitem.title: FRANCE: France fetes Europe Day with special fervour.
newsitem.headline: France fetes Europe Day with special fervour.

text.p: The Eiffel Tower and Paris buses were decked out with gold-starred European flags on Friday as France celebrated Europe Day with a fervour which organisers insisted was unrelated to the parliamentary election campaign.

Some 3,021 events were planned across France, half of them sponsored by the pro-federalist European Movement, to mark the anniversary of Robert Schumann's 1950 founding call for the creation of a Europe community.

European Parliament member Jean-Louis Bourlanges, president of the French section of the European Movement, said half of the 6,000 events taking place throughout the 15-nation European Union on Friday were in France.

In one initiative, students at a technical high school in Blois, in the central Loire Valley, planned to distribute a simple calculator programmed to convert prices from francs to euros, the future single European currency.
In another popular move in the Alpine town of Chambery, bars were serving free drinks from the 15 European Union member states -- to be consumed with moderation, the organisers said.
